articles.summary: A Kodiak Driver-equipped driverless truck ran 64 consecutive days in the Permian Basin, and five more trucks have each passed 45 days of continuous uptime.
articles.title: Kodiak Driver Sets New Uptime Record By Running 64 Consecutive Days on an Unsupervised Driverless Truck

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and DTL Transport sign a binding agreement to deploy 75 driverless trucks on Sun Belt interstate routes under Kodiak’s Driver-As-A-Service model.
articles.title: Kodiak AI and DTL Transport Reach Historic Agreement To Deploy 75 Driverless Trucks As Part of Commercial Driver-As-A-Service Rollout

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and Charger USA now run autonomous trucks between Dallas and Laredo, hauling refrigerated and dry freight on Kodiak's first Laredo route.
articles.title: Kodiak AI and Charger USA Launch Autonomous Trucking Between Dallas and Laredo

articles.summary: Kodiak’s Autonomy Readiness Measure reaches 99%, putting it ahead of pace to launch driverless long-haul service on I-45 by the end of 2026.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Accelerates Toward Driverless Long-Haul Launch as Autonomy Readiness Measure Reaches 99%

articles.summary: Kodiak AI's Autonomy Readiness Measure reached 96% in September, keeping the company on track to launch driverless long-haul service by the end of 2026.
articles.title: Kodiak AI On Track for Year-End Driverless Long-Haul Launch as Autonomy Readiness Measure Jumps to 96%

articles.summary: Kodiak AI uses AWS to scale BreakPoint, its AI-powered safety validation tool, and AI model training ahead of its driverless truck launch in Texas.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Chooses AWS for AI-Powered Autonomous Trucking Technology Development Ahead of Driverless Highway Launch
